subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Identificar e descrever o espaço amostral de eventos aleatórios, realizando contagem das possibilidades, para resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem o cálculo da probabilidade.

components.description_pt: Listar todos os resultados no espaço amostral de um evento aleatório
components.description_en: List all outcomes in the sample space of a random event
components.cc_component_description: Define a sample space and events within the sample space

components.description_pt: Contar o número de resultados favoráveis para um evento especificado dentro de um espaço amostral
components.description_en: Count the number of favorable outcomes for a specified event within a sample space
components.cc_component_description: Identify the outcomes in the sample space which compose the event

components.description_pt: Calcular a probabilidade de um evento simples usando seu espaço amostral
components.description_en: Calculate the probability of a simple event using its sample space
components.cc_component_description: Use a uniform probability model to find the probability of simple events

components.description_pt: Criar problemas envolvendo probabilidade baseados em um espaço amostral descrito
components.description_en: Create problems involving probability based on a described sample space
components.cc_component_description: Develop a probability model based on observed frequencies

cc_matches.description: Describe events as subsets of a sample space (the set of outcomes) using characteristics (or categories) of the outcomes, or as unions, intersections, or complements of other events ("or," "and," "not").

Develop a uniform probability model by assigning equal probability to all outcomes, and use the model to determine probabilities of events. *For example, if a student is selected at random from a class, find the probability that Jane will be selected and the probability that a girl will be selected.*

Develop a probability model (which may not be uniform) by observing frequencies in data generated from a chance process. *For example, find the approximate probability that a spinning penny will land heads up or that a tossed paper cup will land open-end down. Do the outcomes for the spinning penny appear to be equally likely based on the observed frequencies?*

Represent sample spaces for compound events using methods such as organized lists, tables and tree diagrams. For an event described in everyday language (e.g., "rolling double sixes"), identify the outcomes in the sample space which compose the event.

prerequisites.description_pt: Reconhecer, em experimentos aleatórios, eventos independentes e dependentes e calcular a probabilidade de sua ocorrência, nos dois casos.
Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem o cálculo de probabilidade de eventos em experimentos aleatórios sucessivos.

unlocks.description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem o cálculo de probabilidade de eventos em experimentos aleatórios sucessivos.
